reference_mechanisms.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The emission colour and AIE are attributed to intermolecular Au...Au (aurophilic) interactions that appear in aggregates or the amorphous phase and are absent in the blue crystal. Evidence is weak: speculative wording, no structure of the emissive phase.
